cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

#
# This file is generated only once,
# and is not re-generated if converter is called multiple times.
#
# User is free to modify the file as much as necessary
#

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)


# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME RFBoard26)

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Core project settings
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  # Global LTO (Release)
    add_compile_options($<$<CONFIG:Release>:-flto>)
    add_link_options($<$<CONFIG:Release>:-flto>)

# Exclude autogenerated syscalls.c from LTO
set_source_files_properties(
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/syscalls.c
  PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_OPTIONS "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:-fno-lto>"
)
endif()
# Enable CMake support for ASM and C languages
enable_language(C ASM)

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/can_bus.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/radio.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/telemetry_hooks.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/telemetry_thread.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/telemetry.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/neom9n.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/neom9n_config.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/neom9n_thread.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/gps_time.c
)

# Add STM32CubeMX generated sources
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined library search paths
)

# Add include paths
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined include paths
)

# Add project symbols (macros)
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined symbols
)

# Remove wrong libob.a library dependency when using cpp files
list(REMOVE_ITEM CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES ob)

# Add linked libraries
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx

    # Add user defined libraries
)

# Telemetry Library
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_DEVICE_IDENTIFIER "RF" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_MAX_STACK_PAYLOAD "128" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_ENV_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE "1024" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_ENV_STARTING_QUEUE_SIZE "512" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_ENV_QUEUE_GROW_STEP "1.25" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_ENV_MAX_RECENT_RX_IDS "32" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_ENV_STARTING_RECENT_RX_IDS "16" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_ENV_PAYLOAD_COMPRESS_THRESHOLD "30" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sedsprintf_rs)
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} sedsprintf_rs)
set(TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_MASTER_PRIO "1" CACHE STRING "Timesync source priority. Values < 0 make this board a consumer; values >= 0 make it a source with that priority." FORCE)
set(TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_SOURCE_TIMEOUT_MS "5000" CACHE STRING "Time sync source timeout in milliseconds." FORCE)
set(TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL_MS "2000" CACHE STRING "Time sync announce interval in milliseconds." FORCE)
set(TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS "2000" CACHE STRING "Time sync request interval in milliseconds." FORCE)
set(SEDSPRINTF_RS_FORCE_RELEASE ON CACHE BOOL "Build the Rust telemetry library in release mode even for Debug firmware builds" FORCE)

# Option defaults to ON
option(ENABLE_TELEMETRY "Enable the telemetry subsystem" ON)
option(ENABLE_COMMAND_TRACE_PRINTS "Print ground-station command RX and flight-computer CAN TX events" ON)

# Print its state for debugging
message(STATUS "Telemetry enabled: ${ENABLE_TELEMETRY}")
message(STATUS "Command trace prints enabled: ${ENABLE_COMMAND_TRACE_PRINTS}")
if(TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_MASTER_PRIO LESS 0)
    message(STATUS "Telemetry time sync role: CONSUMER (priority ${TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_MASTER_PRIO})")
else()
    message(STATUS "Telemetry time sync role: SOURCE/PRODUCER (priority ${TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_MASTER_PRIO})")
endif()

# Define or undefine the macro globally
add_compile_definitions(
    TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_MASTER_PRIO=${TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_MASTER_PRIO}
    TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_SOURCE_TIMEOUT_MS=${TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_SOURCE_TIMEOUT_MS}U
    TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL_MS=${TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL_MS}U
    TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS=${TELEMETRY_TIMESYNC_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS}U
    COMMAND_TRACE_PRINTS=$<BOOL:${ENABLE_COMMAND_TRACE_PRINTS}>
)

if(ENABLE_TELEMETRY)
    add_compile_definitions(TELEMETRY_ENABLED)
else()
    # Not defined → disabled
endif()
